Andhra Pradesh and Australia Sign MoUs on Education and Energy

The Andhra Pradesh government and Australia have signed Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) focusing on clean energy, manufacturing, education, and skills development. The agreements aim to strengthen vocational education and workforce development. Specific attention is given to inclusive education and student mental health. The MoUs represent a collaboration between the two entities in key developmental sectors.
